content.short: Stackr provides modular SDK for building micro-rollups in general-purpose languages.
content.description: Stackr provides a modular SDK to build micro-rollups in general-purpose languages, unlocking app-specific rollups on Ethereum while leveraging familiar web2 programming environments. Moving beyond app-specificity, Stackr embraces logic-specificity by introducing micro-rollups: isolated state machines that implement individual functions within a decentralized app, which are developed, optimized, and maintained independently. This approach scales Web3 apps by composing functionality as discrete, reusable modules.
